articles.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
articles.description: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

articles.title: OpenAI、AIの行動指針「Model Spec」を改定 “記憶”の使い方や人間による監督を明記
articles.description: OpenAIは、AIの振る舞い指針「Model Spec」の改定版を公開した。全体を5つの価値観に沿って再構成し、メモリや会話履歴の適切な扱い、エージェント自律動作時の人間による監督への服従などを規定。一方で人格設定や詳細な文体規定の大半を削除し、モデル呼称を「the assistant」から「GPT」に改めた。

articles.title: AIは「組織能力の増幅器」、パナソニック新CAIOが描く人とAIの共進化
articles.description: パナソニック ホールディングスでは、2026年4月にグループCAIO（Chief AI Officer）に就任した、執行役員 榊原彰氏が合同取材に応じ、グループ内のAI活用の展望について説明した。

articles.title: 物理ソルバーからMODSIM、AIへ SIMULIAが描く次世代の設計／シミュレーション
articles.description: ダッソー・システムズは「SIMULIA Community Conference Japan 2026」を開催した。基調講演では、SIMULIAブランドの戦略を支える物理ソルバー、MODSIM、AIの3層構造を紹介。エンジニアと協働するAI「バーチャルコンパニオン」や生成型設計、NVIDIAとの協業などを通じて、設計／シミュレーションの将来像を示した。

articles.title: 見積書100枚超をどうさばく？ 「半日仕事」を約30分にした建設会社のAI活用
articles.description: 協力会社ごとに書式が異なる見積書の転記作業に、建設現場は多くの時間を費やしてきた。沖縄県の福地組はAI文書処理サービスを活用し、見積書1枚当たりの処理時間を10?15分から約1分に短縮した。

articles.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
articles.description: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

articles.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
articles.description: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.

articles.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
articles.description: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.

articles.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
articles.description: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your ca…

articles.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
articles.description: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

articles.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
articles.description: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

articles.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
articles.description: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

articles.title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
articles.description: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.

articles.title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
articles.description: Dream is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream's world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit ar…

articles.title: Amazon updates Alexa to help you manage shopping lists and subscriptions and update delivery instructions
articles.description: The update allows you to use Alexa to create lists, register them, see what's on them, and add or edit items. You can also manage subscriptions.

articles.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
articles.description: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

articles.title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
articles.description: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI. Lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.
